simple.summary: סָפַף (çâphaph) means to wait at the threshold First listed occurrence: Ps 84 11.

definitions.full: H5605. saphaph [ ספף verb denominative Hithpô`. stand at, or guard, the threshold ; — Infinitive construct בְּבֵית הִסְתּוֺפֵף אֱלֹהַי בָּחַ֫רְתִּי Psa 84:11 I choose standing at the threshold in the house of my God .
definitions.rootNote: a primitive root; properly, to snatch away, i.e. terminate; but used only as denominative from 5592 (in the sense of a vestibule),
